select
from car_confim_free t left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = t.org_id where t.id = #{id}
select escaped_type, sum(ifnull(dif_amount, 0)) escapedAmount, count(distinct car_id) number from car_except_record where del_flag = '0' group by escaped_type;
select sum(ifnull(amount, 0)) finishedAmount from car_confim_free f where f.del_flag = '0'

find_in_set(#{id}, t.except_ids) > 0
select org_id from car_confim_free where car_id = #{carId} and find_in_set(except_ids, #{id}) > 0;

select o.org_name, group_concat(except_ids) except_ids from car_confim_free c left join ods_yhgl_v_base_org o on c.org_id = o.big_id where del_flag = '0' and c.org_id = #{orgId} and find_in_set(#{escapedType}, c.escaped_types) > 0 and c.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and c.create_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day) group by o.org_name
